title: TSMC Stock (TSM) Falls 1.8% as Chip Stocks Slide (Oct 29)
summary: TSMC (TSM) closed at $431.81 on Oct 29, down 1.75%, as chip stocks fell after Alphabet's revenue miss revived worries about AI spending.
body_markdown:
## Why TSMC Stock Fell


No source we fetched named a TSMC-specific cause for the October 29 decline, so the move is best read against the wider market. Financial media tied the day's tech weakness to[Alphabet's third-quarter revenue miss](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/alphabet-q3-earnings-miss-sinks-stock-reignites-ai-capex-fears-googl-nasdaq-futures/) , which revived concerns about heavy AI capital spending, according to[Reuters](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/wall-street-slides-alphabet-revenue-184007636.html) . Alphabet (GOOGL) closed down 12.64% on the day.


Semiconductor stocks snapped a four-day winning streak on October 29, Reuters reported, as investors tried to separate companies that can fund their large AI plans from those burning cash and borrowing to pay for them. TSMC's decline was in line with that sector move rather than tied to an announcement of its own.


## TSM Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- TSMC reported third-quarter revenue of $46.72 billion, up 41.2% year over year in US dollar terms, with a gross margin of 66.4%, according to the company's[third-quarter earnings release](https://investor.tsmc.com/english/encrypt/files/encrypt_file/reports/2026-10/526b65af7305df2dde6b9ece6812b1fdf1e49f9b/3Q26%20EarningsRelease.pdf) dated October 15, 2026.
- The company guided fourth-quarter revenue of $52.3 billion to $54.3 billion. CFO Wendell Huang said TSMC expects "continued strong demand for our leading-edge process technologies, including the steep ramp-up of our 2-nanometer technology."
- Bell Global Equities Fund's third-quarter letter, as reported by[Insider Monkey](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/why-bell-global-equities-fund-163432457.html) on October 29, cited TSMC's August sales rising 36% year over year and a collaboration with ASML on High-NA EUV lithography, where "commercial adoption is not expected until 2030 onwards."


### Risks


- Doubts over AI spending weighed on the whole chip group on October 29, and Reuters reported investors were sorting AI spenders that can fund their plans from those burning cash and borrowing.
- Four construction workers died at TSMC's new factory site in Kaohsiung on October 20, and the company suspended similar steel structure work at all its construction sites across Taiwan pending its investigation, according to Reuters as published by[The Star](https://www.thestar.com.my/aseanplus/aseanplus-news/2026/10/21/tsmc-says-four-construction-workers-killed-at-taiwan-site-halting-work) .
- TSMC's own release lists cyclicality and market conditions in the semiconductor industry among the risks that could make actual results differ from its outlook.
